title: Updates to the whole array use the spare cell
notes: A = 5 3 8 1 4 2 and three updates that all end at the last value, so each writes its stop into D[6], the spare cell past the end, which nothing reads. D holds only the changes (1 at D[0], 3 at D[2]), and the pass adds them to A's own values: 6 4 12 5 8 6.
